name: Secret
description: Hidden facts that are true in the generated fiction

fields.description: A person with the {{ background:official.generator.name }} background secretly reports to {{ faction.name }}.
A concealed chamber lies beneath the building known as {{ building.name }}, and its current purpose is known to only a few people.
A government following the {{ government.name }} model is concealing a dangerous institutional failure that has not yet become public.
The genuine revered relic of the religion known as {{ religion.name }} has been secretly replaced; {{ faction.name }} or another unknown group may hold the original.
A respected person with the {{ background.generator.name }} background is being blackmailed over information that has never become public.
Attacks attributed to a creature identified as {{ monster.name }} are being staged by ordinary people for an undisclosed purpose.
A legitimate supply network secretly moves the material known as {{ material.name }} through systematic {{ crime:smuggling.name }}.
A person with the {{ background.generator.name }} background lives under a carefully maintained false identity.
Two people—one with the {{ background.generator.name }} background and the other with the {{ background.generator.name }} background—share an undisclosed family relationship.
{{ faction.name }} maintains a hidden pact with influential followers of the religion known as {{ religion.name }}.
The following criminal activity is being concealed to protect the current leadership of a government following the {{ government.name }} model: {{ crime.name }}.
The unusual item known as {{ curio.name }} was never destroyed as publicly claimed and remains hidden in uncertain hands.
Senior members of {{ faction.name }} knowingly protect a network devoted to {{ crime.name }}.
The succession records of a government following the {{ government.name }} model were deliberately altered, though the intended beneficiary remains uncertain.
The leaders of the religion known as {{ religion.name }} removed a genuine teaching from public doctrine and concealed every surviving copy.
A living creature identified as {{ monster.name }} is secretly bound beneath a site described as {{ site.generator.name }}.
{{ faction.name }} is secretly destroying or withholding the material known as {{ material.name }} to manufacture a profitable shortage.
A person with the {{ background.generator.name }} background is the unrecognized legal heir to the leadership of a government following the {{ government.name }} model and may not know it.
{{ faction.name }} and {{ faction.name }} secretly coordinate their public hostility to manipulate outsiders.
Maps of the region known as {{ region.name }} are systematically altered to conceal the existence of a site described as {{ site.generator.name }}.
Important memories were magically removed from someone with the {{ background.generator.name }} background, who believes the gaps are natural.
A government following the {{ government.name }} model secretly funds work involving {{ service.name }} on behalf of {{ faction.name }}.
The owner of the building known as {{ building.name }} knowingly shelters people carrying out the following offense: {{ crime.name }}.
The official founding history of {{ faction.name }} was forged to hide its original dependence on a government following the {{ government.name }} model.
A person with the {{ background.generator.name }} background who was declared dead is alive and hidden inside a site described as {{ site.generator.name }}.
Two governments, one following the {{ government.name }} model and the other following the {{ government.name }} model, secretly answer to the same unelected council.
The building known as {{ building.name }} is a living being that has begun to awaken and subtly reshape its interior.

The sacred protections maintained by the religion known as {{ religion.name }} at a site described as {{ site.generator.name }} have already failed, but its leaders continue to stage reassuring rites.
